periods.analysis: We opened the year with 14 social connection events and 420 attendees, most of them indoors at library branches and the Bayshore Baby Cafe. Winter weather slowed door-to-door outreach to isolated residents, but 988 messaging and the online resource directory launched on schedule.
periods.recommendations: Add a second outreach worker for spring and move part of the event calendar outdoors in Riverside.

periods.analysis: Spring lifted the calendar to 19 events and 610 attendees, and outreach contacts climbed to 164 once door-to-door visits resumed on Old Ferry Road. Outreach staff now hand residents a directory card at every contact, which ties the gathering, outreach and 988 strategies together in practice.
periods.recommendations: Use the summer to expand outdoor programming and test evening hours for the Baby Cafe.

periods.analysis: Social connection programming nearly doubled its reach this year, with 26 events and programs and 905 attendees in Q3 against 14 and 420 in Q1. The new-parent groups, isolation outreach and 988 awareness strategies are reinforcing each other, since outreach staff now hand residents a resource-directory card at every contact. The remaining work is to reach residents who do not come to events at all.
periods.recommendations: Extend programming through winter with indoor venues and track repeat attendance.
